title: Admin login bypass with SQL injection
impact: Log in as the admin account without knowing the password, so full control of that account.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements instead of building the SQL string from user input.

title: Dumping user credentials with a UNION injection
payload_used: qwert')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM Users--
impact: The search can be made to return the Users table, leaking every user's email and password hash.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and never concatenate the search term into the SQL.

title: Reflected XSS in the product search
impact: Runs attacker JavaScript in the victim's browser, which can be used to steal their session token.
remediation: Escape/encode output, don't render user input as HTML, and add a Content-Security-Policy.

title: Stored XSS in a product description
impact: The payload is saved in the database and runs for anyone who opens that product, so it hits other users too.
remediation: Validate and sanitize input on the server, escape output when rendering, and add a CSP.
